aligned_B.cache_policy: reuse 5080-verified normalized metrics and small selected checkpoints; six feature caches remain remote on 5080

minimum_for_strict_live_prior_artifact_c.description: B checkpoint+summary+history for all datasets, Taxi FULL checkpoint+summary+history, and three aligned-B checkpoint+summary pairs. Intermittent and Instacart FULL runs already exist on 5090 with exact hashes.

portable_single_package_option.description: Include all B/FULL checkpoint+summary+history triples and all aligned-B checkpoint+summary pairs. This duplicates two verified FULL runs but removes dependency on external artifact roots; still excludes about 900 MiB aligned caches.

transfer_assessment.training_only: No prior checkpoint transfer is required to train the new bounded candidate from scratch; prior artifacts are required for strict baseline/full reuse and normalized-time comparison routes.
